title: RossFast D3R 36-material production envelope
purpose: Expand only the admitted RossFast D3R Staringreeks material catalog from the six F-ROSS12 materials to the full 36-material unimodal Mualem-van Genuchten KSATFIT catalog while preserving the existing solver, geometry, transaction, retry, commit and production routing contracts.

transient_evidence_reconciliation.conclusion: No immutable historical evidence recovered so far qualifies transient/timestep D3R behavior for all 36 materials. Face-table qualification cannot be promoted to transient production admission.

qualification_required_before_any_produc: Run a qualification-only transient gate for the full 36-material catalog, with special attention to the 30 materials not covered by historical Gate F/D3R evidence.
Use pinned research/oracle authority and the exact historical N241 fingerprints already materialized; do not establish authority by production output.
Keep the existing fixed geometry and physical envelope unchanged: homogeneous 16-cell, 10-cm cells and the established prescribed-flux unsaturated D3R route.
Exercise the qualified timestep/piecewise route and temporal-certificate semantics rather than only constitutive face evaluations.
Require finite-state, MvG-domain, head-envelope, storage/mass-ledger and temporal/refinement gates; fail closed per material.
Do not alter src/runtime/mod_rossfast_d3r_model_binding.f90 or src/solver/mod_rossfast_d3r_table_provider.f90 until this transient qualification passes.
next_permitted_action: Construct and run a qualification-only all-36 transient D3R gate from pinned F-ROSS01/F-ROSS12 scientific authority. Production material allowlists remain unchanged until that gate passes.
